subject: Options denied!
author: Xandu
body:
Criterion Games is not know for giving their players options to customize their games. SFX and Music Volume and that's it, I'm sure if they could they would not even give us those options 😃.

So no, there is no way to turn off the crash cam in Burnout Paradise.

-- The Creator --

subject: Lots o takedowns
author: Xandu
body:
That is a good takedown score. I normally end up somewhere around 60-80. Not sure what my best is. I prefer racing with the takedown cam off since you have a little bit more control over your car that way.

My favourite track for takedowns must be Silver Lake using one of the slower and heavier cars.

 -- The Creator --
